ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, KEYSTONE CLUB TOKYO and current Japanese jazz sources produced no new unrecorded Tsuyoshi Yamamoto performance. This Yokosuka catch-up clears RADAR admission because SUPER BRASS STARS expands Eijiro Nakagawa, Eric Miyashiro and Masato Honda into an XXL large ensemble with Yosuke Onuma, Senri Kawaguchi and a special guest appearance by flamenco guitarist Jin Oki. The grade is A+, not S: the exact lineup and brass/fusion/flamenco collision merit active prioritization, while SUPER BRASS STARS XXL is an established recurring project rather than a premiere, farewell or otherwise scarce one-off.

events.factual_description: Yokosuka Arts Theatre presents SUPER BRASS STARS XXL EDITION on Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 2:00 PM, with doors at 1:15 PM, as the New Year Special in the Yokosuka Jazz Dreams live series. The official venue page confirms Eijiro Nakagawa, Eric Miyashiro and Masato Honda at the center of the large ensemble and names Hikaru Honma, Tatsuhiko Yoshizawa, Yosuke Onuma, Ryu Kawamura, Senri Kawaguchi and Naruhito Nakagawa, with flamenco guitarist Jin Oki as special guest. The venue lists general ticket sales beginning September 5, 2026; the exact eplus page independently confirms the full lineup, date, time and authorized ticket-sale window.

en.why_it_matters: The attraction is the instrumental collision inside the XXL format: Nakagawa, Miyashiro and Honda already give the front line three very different brass voices, then Yosuke Onuma and Senri Kawaguchi turn the rhythm section into a real fusion engine. Adding Jin Oki's flamenco guitar introduces another attack, harmonic language and rhythmic vocabulary rather than simply another celebrity name. It is a large ensemble built around players whose individual sound is immediately identifiable.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Yokosuka afternoon if the Kanto calendar reaches January. The lineup is strong enough to build the day around, especially if the Japan thread is following brass, saxophone, guitar and high-level fusion playing; because XXL is an established SUPER BRASS STARS format rather than a singular premiere or farewell, it should complement rather than displace a truly scarce one-off elsewhere in the trip.

es.why_it_matters: Lo atractivo está en la colisión instrumental del formato XXL: Nakagawa, Miyashiro y Honda ya ponen al frente tres voces de metales muy distintas, y luego Yosuke Onuma y Senri Kawaguchi convierten a la sección rítmica en un verdadero motor de fusión. La entrada de Okin Jin con guitarra flamenca agrega otro ataque, otro lenguaje armónico y otro vocabulario rítmico; no es simplemente otro nombre famoso en el cartel. Es un ensamble grande construido alrededor de músicos cuyo sonido individual se reconoce de inmediato.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a la tarde de Yokosuka si el calendario de Kanto llega hasta enero. La alineación da para construir el día alrededor del concierto, sobre todo si el hilo japonés viene siguiendo metales, sax, guitarra y fusión de altísimo nivel; como XXL es un formato ya establecido de SUPER BRASS STARS y no un estreno o despedida singular, lo usaría para complementar y no para desplazar un one-off realmente escaso en otro punto del viaje.
